text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My body feels sluggish—like a fish
out of water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open my eyes and find myself in an
empty classroom with Agnes
Tachyon
beside me. It's already evening.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're perspiring profusely. Your body
temperature... Yes, you're
burning up
quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You may be a guinea pig, but your body
disperses heat just like a
human. But I
suppose we'd have a problem if you didn't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look down at my body... and find myself
strapped down to a
mysterious device!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This reminds me of when we first met. But things are a little different. This is my personal laboratory. Here, no one will get in my way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm here because you wished for
experimentation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who prepared this
environment. As such, is it not
fitting to
christen this as my laboratory?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Know this—a guinea pig's duty is
to accept all phenomena
as experiments
waiting to happen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who chose to be my
guinea pig. Do you think
you're in a
position to demand when, where, or how
my experiments
proceed?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If I am to surpass my limits and realize the
latent potential of
Umamusume-kind, then
I must devote myself to research—in other

words, more experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll have you ingest my newest
creation. Look, this one glows a
pleasant
blue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... With this, your muscular
strength will increase a
thousandfold,
giving birth to a body surpassing that of
any monster!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, open wide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm helpless before her. After all, I did
volunteer to be her guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I brace myself and slowly open my
mouth—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good morning, my guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I squint my eyes as rays of light assault my
pupils. Could the medicine
from earlier
have been...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You look rather frightened, you
know? Did you have a nightmare
or
something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The lighting hasn't changed, yet your
pupils are dilated.
Heh-heh-heh... You've
piqued my interest. Go on, tell me all
about it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even now, modern science is unable to
explain the precise
mechanisms of how we
dream. However, from the lens of depth

psychology...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We can infer that the image of me within
your subconscious is of an
Umamusume
who experiments on people without
considering their
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At any rate... I see. I can’t believe I did all
that in your dream.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... I really said, "Open wide"? The
Tachyon in your dream
actually bothered
asking?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As if a guinea pig had any choice in the
matter!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! What're you looking surprised
for? Did you forget that
you're my
personal test subject?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A shame about earlier, though. Just a little bit more and I would've quietly poured some Medicine-β down your gullet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just to be clear, I was trying to show you
mercy, okay? While β works
wonders, it
comes at the cost of its rancid taste.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But instead of me trying to pour 120
milliliters of β down your throat
without
spilling, be a dear and flush it down
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Much easier than having to force your
mouth open after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, my dear little guinea pig?
Step one—take the medicine
from my
hand. Step two—drink it. Easy enough,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Murmur murmur...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the side effects of β, I'm stuck
with my thighs glowing
blue—and the local
population's judging stares—for quite
some time.
